title: Jumanji
desc: While playing a board game, two children release a man who has been trapped in it for years and the dangers that come with him.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
desc: Thor is imprisoned on the planet Sakaar, and must race against time to return to Asgard and stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his world, at the hands of the powerful and ruthless villain Hela.

title: Tangled
desc: Rapunzel, a curious girl locked away by her strict mother, gets her first taste of freedom when she meets Flynn, a kind thief who helps her explore the world.

title: Crawl
desc: In a wild twist of fate, a woman battles alligators that invade her flooded home, showcasing her incredible bravery and resourcefulness while navigating chaos in the most unexpected situation.

title: King Of Serpant
desc: When Chen Zheng and his friends go to King Serpent Island to collect data on snakes, they encounter evil snake catchers led by Jin Laosi. Will Chen Zheng be able to save the island and its snakes?

title: Thor: Love And Thunder
desc: Thor embarks on a mission to uncover the God Butcher's motive, halt his vendetta, and prevent a catastrophic threat to the cosmos. Courage, friendship, and sacrifice unfold.

title: Nezha
desc: The Hanji Box tells a moving cross-cultural story where art, heritage, and human connection lead to healing and self-discovery.

title: Sword Master
desc: Hong Kong cinema giants Derek Yee and Tsui Hark join forces in this 3D martial arts epic, about an elite swordsman who is haunted by his skill, and a challenger who aims to take his place at all costs.
